About

I’m Mcondisi Khumalo, a student at the University of Botswana studying Financial Mathematics. I like how fashion and finance both come down to patterns, risk, and good judgment.

My favorite brands are Polo, Jonathan D, David Jones, and Tommy Hilfiger. I mix clean basics with wide-leg trousers, knit polos, and a good pair of loafers.

Fashion, styling, content creation, financial mathematics, problem solving.
